title: Market Research: Crypto Storage Solutions
body:

## ARWEAVE

- Archival Service
- AR Drive Launched 
- Bundler Payments 





_Main Benefit: _**Blockchain** **Integrations **

Solana stores their blockchain data using Arweave. The Graph using AR to allow developers to analyze and incorporate all data stored on the AR Chain. Candidate for archiving ETH's upcoming (EIP-4444) data burn.

_Main Concern:_  **Data Integrity** and **Performance**
 
Their IWF support and stated future compliancy with requests for data removal may impact your availability or retrieval of archived data.

Multiple posts from users regarding slowness when retrieving and uploading files. Data upload and retrieval speeds still unknown.
